description: Look at a picture with a grown-up. Hear a friend, then say a word or a sentence.

tier.name: Starting support

A.studentGoal: I can say a word about a picture.

info.headline: I can say a word about a picture.
info.summary: Talk task 1: name what you see.
canDo: I can say a word about a picture.

activities.title: What Do You See?
activities.directions: Look at the garden. Say one thing you see.
activities.directionsEs: Mira el huerto. Di una cosa que ves.
vocabulary: the pretty colored part of a plant
flor: la parte bonita y de color de una planta
activities.hint: Hear the model student first. Then use the sentence starter.
activities.support: Hear the model student first. Then use the sentence starter.
activities.extension: Say your answer again with one new detail.
wida: Name an object in an image

teacher.use: With a grown-up beside the child. The grown-up may tap the speaker, point, and repeat; the child answers by pointing or saying a word.
teacher.lower: Accept single words and pointing. Repeat the child's words back in a full sentence.
teacher.onLevel: Use the sentence starter, then add one more detail.
teacher.challenge: Ask for a reason with because, or a sequence with first, next, last.
teacher.noTech: Show the picture on paper, say the model answer, and let the child answer aloud.
teacher.prompt: Tell me more. What else do you see?

activities.title: A Snowy Day
activities.skill: Telling about the weather and clothes
activities.directions: Look at the snow. Tell what the weather is. Tell what the child has.
activities.directionsEs: Mira la nieve. Di cómo está el tiempo. Di qué tiene el niño.
activities.prompt: What is the weather? What does the child have?
activities.promptEs: ¿Cómo está el tiempo? ¿Qué tiene el niño?

modelStudent.name: Amira, age 5
modelStudent.text: It is snowing. He has a hat.

models.B: It is snowing. He has a hat.

sayFor: I said a word or a short sentence.
successCriteria: I said a word or a short sentence.
vocabulary: soft white flakes of frozen water
nieve: copos blancos y suaves de agua congelada
